topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: When I heard the news, it was like someone reached in and twisted a little piece of my heart. My favorite restaurant, the one with the warm lighting and that corner booth I always claimed, is going to close. They said it’s the last month. I can’t just let it slide, can I? I need to go there every day now, just to soak it all in, order my usual, maybe even try something new. But it won’t be the same, will it? It’s not just the food, it’s the feeling. I’m planning every visit, trying to freeze these moments, but time is slipping through my fingers. What will I do when it’s gone?
